repo.ISSUE.md: label_readings gives me the lookup, but `lines` is always empty. I expected one line per reading.

fix.code:
def label_readings(names, readings):
    """Return (lookup, lines): a name -> level dict and one 'name: level' line per reading."""
    pairs = list(zip(names, (x.level for x in readings)))
    lookup = dict(pairs)
    lines = ["%s: %s" % (name, value) for name, value in pairs]
    return lookup, lines
